"""Runtime compat shims so the 2016-era sympy imports on Python 3.12.
Not part of the project; lives in /tmp and is loaded with pytest -p shim312.
"""
import collections
import collections.abc
import inspect

for _n in ('Mapping', 'MutableMapping', 'Sequence', 'Iterable', 'Callable',
           'MutableSet', 'Hashable', 'OrderedDict', 'MutableSequence', 'Set'):
    if not hasattr(collections, _n):
        setattr(collections, _n, getattr(collections.abc, _n))

if not hasattr(inspect, 'getargspec'):
    _ArgSpec = collections.namedtuple(
        'ArgSpec', 'args varargs keywords defaults')

    def _getargspec(func):
        s = inspect.getfullargspec(func)
        return _ArgSpec(s.args, s.varargs, s.varkw, s.defaults)

    inspect.getargspec = _getargspec
